_about: Public school pack for one school. Data only: no behavior, no family information. Every fact file cites its original sources. Another school copies this folder and edits it; the tools read everything school-specific from here.
maintained_by: parents; not an official school or district service
weekly_notes: Wednesdays: early release for all K-8. Regular dismissal (K-5) is 3:10pm Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri, 2:10pm Wed.

Minimum-day clock times are not in the district calendar. The only printed ones are for conference week (K-5 8:45am-1:25pm, Sep 20, 2026 principal newsletter). For other minimum days, check the teacher's newsletter; never guess a time.
known_date_errors: A September principal newsletter listed Labor Day as Aug 31. It is Mon Sep 7.
The PTO's redrawn district calendar image is missing 4 minimum days; this list has them.
PTO event pages on seespto.org (book fair, fun run, talent show, monster bash) still show past years' dates. Don't quote them.

suggested_school_senders.note: Suggestions only. The parent's agreement sets what is searched.
